title: Work done, milestone not yet reached

company.company_business: IT implementation and managed services for mid-size Indian businesses

narrative_template:
Kalmira has recognised ₹12,00,000 of revenue for work done on {customer}'s project. Under the contract it can invoice only when the next milestone is accepted, which has not happened yet. What does Kalmira show?

Round amounts to the nearest rupee and percentages to one decimal place. All names are fictional.

rubric.text: Right conditional on the milestone: contract asset.

explanation: A right to consideration that depends on something other than time, such as the next milestone, is a contract asset (para 107).

mistakes.feedback: A receivable needs an unconditional right, where only the passage of time is left (para 108). Here the right still depends on the milestone, so it is a contract asset (para 107).
A contract liability arises when the customer pays or is billed ahead of performance. Here performance is ahead of billing.
